acknowledged.prop:published-class-converse-transfer: This is a delivered comparison result: it embeds the benchmark into a larger published-style Gaussian class, transfers the lower bound, and precisely states the one-way Pei--Shen relationship while keeping Dong provenance-only. It belongs in the interpretation section even though no later proof consumes it.
acknowledged.thm:uniform-frontier-resolution: This is the paper's flagship consolidation theorem: it states the matched minimax risk and honest-interval frontier, the attaining procedures, all three noise branches, their interfaces, and the representative shrinking-noise specialization. As the terminal headline result, it is intentionally not consumed by another frozen statement.
